distributed_artifact_observation.evidence_note: Exact JAR bytes were not acquired in this TECH-HUB pass. Artifact symbols are accepted only where public projects/issues explicitly state they were derived or verified against the official 2.6.5 jar.

mapping_technique.policy: SAFE_ONLY style: unique structural candidate required; ambiguity retained.

chinese_community_public_compat.note: Only Java-level compatibility, descriptors, logs, structural mappings and high-level architecture are retained. Protection-bypass/decryption recipes are excluded.

confidence_definitions.CONFIRMED: Actual-2.6.5 artifact-facing public evidence supplies an exact owner/member descriptor or exact structural target, and the semantic identity has a unique matching official/readable implementation role.
confidence_definitions.HIGH: Actual-2.6.5 artifact-facing evidence and event/log/call-chain structure identify one semantic role, but exact source identity or one member name cannot be proven from the currently acquired public evidence.
confidence_definitions.MEDIUM: Structure is compatible with a semantic target but at least one meaningful alternative remains.
confidence_definitions.LOW: Only cross-version/lineage evidence supports the candidate.
confidence_definitions.UNKNOWN: No defensible semantic identity has been assigned.

key_rule: A member mapping key is owner + member + JVM descriptor. Obfuscated member text alone is never an identity.
contradiction_rules: If a future exact 2.6.5 JAR scan yields multiple structural candidates, downgrade to AMBIGUOUS.
A JVM descriptor mismatch invalidates a member mapping.
A mismatch between distributed-artifact evidence and the public release-line source candidate is SOURCE_ARTIFACT_DIVERGENCE; do not overwrite either track.
Evidence from another Minecraft/YSM version is comparative only unless independently reproduced on the 2.6.5 Forge 1.20.1 anchor.
